class LRUEntry:

        expiry_time: The absolute time when this entry expires
        last_access: The time when this entry was last accessed
    """

    def __init__(self, key: Hashable, value: Any, expiry_time: float, last_access: float):

        self.value = value
        self.expiry_time = expiry_time
        self.last_access = last_access

        """
        Check if this entry has expired.
        
        Args:

        Returns:

        """

        return current_time >= self.expiry_time
